facts.text: Two car parks. Up to 30 minutes free if you register on the RingGo app or the machine (you cannot register for another free half hour for 2 hours after leaving); 30 minutes to 1 hour £1; longer than an hour £1 per hour. Charges apply at all times, including bank holidays. Blue Badge parking is free.
